tools.name: .NET SDK 9
tools.why: builds and tests the API (9.0.200 is the first band that reads .slnx)

tools.name: PowerShell 7
tools.why: runs the build, release and deploy scripts

tools.name: SQL Server LocalDB (Windows) or a SQL Server reachable through TEST_SQL_CONNECTION
tools.why: database tests and local runs; on macOS/Linux use a SQL Server container and set TEST_SQL_CONNECTION instead

install.windows: winget install --id Microsoft.SQLServer.2022.Express -e   (choose LocalDB in the installer), or install LocalDB from https://learn.microsoft.com/sql/database-engine/configure-windows/sql-server-express-localdb
install.macos: docker run -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=<strong password> -p 1433:1433 -d mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest   then set TEST_SQL_CONNECTION
install.linux: docker run -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=<strong password> -p 1433:1433 -d mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest   then set TEST_SQL_CONNECTION

tools.name: Azure CLI (with Bicep)
tools.why: deploys infrastructure and images, runs migrations as you; not needed until the first deployment

install.windows: winget install --id Microsoft.AzureCLI -e   then: az bicep install
install.macos: brew install azure-cli   then: az bicep install
install.linux: curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash   then: az bicep install

tools.name: sqlcmd (go-sqlcmd)
tools.why: grants the app's identity access to the database (Grant-DatabaseAccess.ps1)
